_readme: Tax tables are DATA, not code. Dollar amounts are whole dollars per YEAR; rates are percent strings (converted to exact integer ppm). Every block carries `verified` — the payroll service refuses to FINALIZE a payroll run while any block it uses is unverified, unless the company is in calculate-only (beta) mode. Only the Professional Review Board may set verified=true, recording reviewer and source.

federal.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (2026 brackets & standard deduction); SSA 2026 wage base; Pub 15-T Worksheet 1A method. Verify against final 2026 Pub 15-T.

futa._note: Net rate after the full 5.4% state credit. Credit-reduction states (announced by US DOL each November) are a year-end true-up on Form 940, not a per-paycheck amount.

TX.source: Texas has no personal income tax. TWC taxable wage base $9,000; new-employer rate 2.7% (company's assigned rate overrides).

CO.source: CO DOR DR 1098 (flat rate x (annualized wages - DR 0004 allowance)); FAMLI 2026 premium 0.88% split 50/50, capped at SS wage base; CDLE UI wage base per SB20-207 schedule. Rate & allowance table MUST be verified against the 2026 DR 1098.

incomeTax._allowanceNote: Annual allowance comes from the employee's DR 0004 (line 2). Default allowances for employees without a DR 0004 are null until the board enters the DR 1098 table; the engine will refuse to guess.

CA.source: CA EDD DE 44 Method B (exact calculation). VALUES BELOW ARE 2025 DE 44 FIGURES CARRIED FORWARD — must be replaced with the 2026 DE 44. SDI 2026 1.3%, no wage cap. UI wage base $7,000; ETT 0.1%.

DC.source: DC OTR brackets (TY2022+): 4/6/6.5/8.5/9.25/9.75/10.75%. Withholding method (standard deduction + D-4 allowances) must be verified against the current DC withholding instructions. Paid Family Leave employer-only 0.75%. DOES UI wage base $9,000 + 0.2% administrative assessment.
